---
title: "asreml"
subtitle: "ASReml-R: linear mixed models fitted by REML"
---

ASReml-R is a commercial package from VSN International (VSNi) for fitting linear mixed models with residual maximum likelihood (REML). wgaim and asremlPlus both build on it.

::: {.callout-note}
asreml is not on CRAN. You need a licence from VSNi to install and run it.
:::

## Documentation

::: {.resource-list}
- [ASReml-R Reference Manual, version 4.2 (PDF)](https://asreml.kb.vsni.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/ASReml-R-Reference-Manual-4.2.pdf)
- [Reference manuals and other docs (ASReml Knowledge Base)](https://asreml.kb.vsni.co.uk/knowledge-base/asreml_r_documentation/)
- [ASReml-R product page (VSNi)](https://vsni.co.uk/software/asreml-r/)
:::

## Install

Download the installer for your platform from VSNi and activate it with your licence, following the installation guide in the knowledge base.
